column1: rung04
column3: SPITBOL manual Ch6 "Pattern Matching with Replacement" pp.72-74 + Ch14 "Program Statements" (pattern-match-with-replacement form) p.175
column8: seat07 2026-09-04: rung04 FORMS complete per pp.72-74/p.175. Minted null_replacement_deletes (p.72: bare `=` with no replacement field deletes the match, verbatim T?'NOTHING'= step of the book's own MUCH-ADO example), first_occurrence_only (p.73: "if the matched substring appears more than once ... only the first occurrence is changed", BANANA/A->O), match_fails_no_replacement (p.72: "If it fails ... replacement does not occur", subject unchanged, no goto needed -- fall-through alone proves it, stays isolation-clean), replacement_expression_value (p.74: "SPITBOL allows you to place the subject, pattern, and replacement within parentheses and used as an expression" -- book's own paren examples all use explicit `?`, e.g. `(RAINBOW ? CYCLE = REST ITEM ',')`; my first attempt omitted `?` and both scrip (BOMB/abort) and the oracle (syntax ERROR 212) rejected it -- corrected to `(T ? "ADO" = "FUSS")` matching the book's own syntax, oracle now rc=0 "MUCH FUSS ABOUT NOTHING"). All 4 oracle-cut from SPITBOL -bf, scrip --run cross-checked before absorbing. replacement_expression_value is a GENUINE RED WITNESS, not a mistake: scrip FATAL "lower_snobol4 (GZ#5 subset): pattern element not in the SN4-PAT subset ... IR_MATCH_* family pending" on both m3/m4 -- parenthesized pattern-match-with-replacement-as-expression is simply not lowered yet (top-level statement form works fine, rung04's OTHER 4 witnesses prove it). Per THERE IS NO XFAIL, the absorb tool's auto xfail=True (banner " XFAIL") was hand-reverted in ALL.csv+ALL.sno+ALL.ref (xfail is computed from `orig_green` at absorb time, which is always false for a witness that documents a real unimplemented-feature gap -- the tool has no way to know the red is deliberate) so the ladder runner counts it as a genuine FAIL, not an excused XFAIL; class row filed to hq_P (own lane, lower_snobol4-scoped, not a shared-node defect) -- see FINDING-2026-09-04-seat07-rung04-parenthesized-replace-expression-unimplemented.md. Deliberate NON-form: `"MASH" "M" = "B"` (p.72's literal-subject-illegal example, book's Error #212) -- excluded, NOT a form here: the shared oracle `sbl -bf` SIGSEGVs on this input's error-recovery path nondeterministically (3 crashes / 3 clean over 6 identical runs), so no reliable oracle-cut .ref is possible without hand-typing one (forbidden); a future session may revisit once the oracle crash itself is understood -- see the same FINDING doc, which also covers the oracle instability as a separate shared-infra hazard.
